metadata.description: Hybrid prompt linter for Claude Code — deterministic Node detector + LLM model layer. Flags prompt-engineering bugs, never rewrites.

plugins.name: prompt-refiner
plugins.description: Hybrid prompt linter — deterministic Node detector for 18 of 20 rules plus an LLM model layer for pronoun antecedents, persona conflicts, and semantic cases of hybrid rules. Lint, don't rewrite. Markdown or JSON output, suppression comments, baseline mode, conformance corpus (25 cases), CI recipes. Never imposes a framework, never asks clarifying questions, never auto-rewrites.
